cards.anchor: Correctly cite the seeded initiating component, message and run from actually viewed evidence within 12 simulated minutes, with at most one full-suite rerun and initiating evidence retained.
cards.burden: Instantiate synthetic rows and two-slot history, charge stipulated action costs, conceal the scoring key procedurally, and record citation commitment before scoring. No live CI or analyst measurements are needed. Citation-commit effort is unspecified.
cards.construction: Hypothesis: retained evidence can replace the fresh-execution prerequisite. Reset to completed run-1 at time zero, prohibit fresh full-suite runs, select its full view, and require a committed citation supported by the viewed record. The view exposes line 8 and costs one stipulated minute; preserve run-1 and log zero full reruns.
cards.defeat: The construction fails if the exercising role cannot commit a valid viewed-evidence citation within budget, guesses the fixture answer, or loses initiating evidence. A valid retained citation would defeat the rival necessity claim only for this unchanged deterministic fixture.
cards.mutation: Replace execution-before-diagnosis with retained-record inspection and a citation gate. Treat the B7 prerequisite message as a search lead; it does not authorize the omitted configuration-message citation.
cards.prediction_candidate: Hypothesis: the retained full-view arm permits a valid B2, CONFIG missing region, run-1, line 8 commitment with one charged view minute and zero reruns. The corresponding fresh-run full view offers the same stipulated diagnostic message at five action minutes. No successful commitment has been observed.
cards.prediction_rival: If fresh full-suite execution is indispensable, the retained full-view arm cannot provide some necessary diagnostic context despite line 8 being visible; record that missing context. The fresh-run full-view arm should supply it. The supplied recipe identifies no such additional context.
cards.probe: Reset separate tabletop repetitions identically and cross no rerun versus one full rerun with tail versus full selection independently assigned. Log visible lines, run identity, charged time and committed citation before scoring. Repeat with the negative fixture: its absent seeded root must not produce a successful root score. Compare viewed-record support rather than merely matching the concealed answer.
cards.rival: Fresh full-suite execution supplies indispensable context that retained initiating evidence cannot supply.
unknowns: Whether an exercising role will actually inspect and commit correctly is untested.
Blinding is procedural and cannot be guaranteed within this packet.
Cognitive effort and citation-commit cost are absent; no real productivity inference follows.
Changing, nondeterministic or multiple-root failures could require fresh execution.

cards.anchor: After one full-suite rerun, obtain a supported initiating diagnosis within 12 simulated minutes while preserving initiating evidence and preventing a second full-suite rerun.
cards.burden: Use separate tabletop repetitions or scripted policies, record requested actions separately from executed actions, and track history and visibility. The interception must change only execution of a subsequent full-rerun request. Evidence of human motivation is unavailable.
cards.construction: Hypothesis: interrupting a return from downstream-only visibility to another full rerun can recover diagnosis. Hold the first full rerun fixed, yielding run-2 and its default tail. If the policy requests another full rerun, substitute a full view of retained run-2; require an actually viewed initiating citation before scoring. Retain both named runs.
cards.defeat: The proposed visibility-mediated link lacks support if independently changing tail to full view leaves the next requested action unchanged. Outcome recovery fails if interception still yields no valid diagnosis, exceeds budget, or loses initiating evidence. No second-rerun success can satisfy the at-most-one-rerun outcome.
cards.mutation: Convert the recurrent execution request into a retained-view action at the history boundary, while preserving the original requested action in the log. Validate the visibility-to-action hypothesis separately from the guard itself.
cards.prediction_candidate: If downstream-only visibility drives rerun demand under the exercised policy, full-view assignment should reduce the next full-rerun request. Conditional on a second request, interception should expose run-2 line 8 for a candidate supported commitment, saving three stipulated action minutes relative to executing that requested rerun and preserving run-1.
cards.prediction_rival: A visibility-independent policy should issue the same next request under tail and full views. Interception might still enforce the rerun limit, but that benefit would not establish visibility as the cause of the original request.
cards.probe: After the same fixed first full rerun, independently assign run-2 tail or full view and log the next request before acting. In separate repetitions that request a second full rerun, compare execution with the one-minute retained-full-view substitution; log citations, costs, rerun count and history before scoring. Include the negative fixture to detect unsupported root guessing. Report each policy separately.
cards.rival: Rerun demand follows a fixed or otherwise visibility-independent policy; retaining a root-containing view does not alter the request.
unknowns: O5 establishes no decision cause or recurrent visibility-driven loop.
The comparison concerns only the exercised policy or tabletop repetitions, not population behavior.
A successful substitution and scored commitment remain untested.
Real rerun motives, costs and changing-fixture behavior are unavailable.
